answer: One concrete mechanism: cap each identity's voting weight by a staked bond locked for the full epoch, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital. An attacker reaching the sybil nadir sees each clone earn only a sliver of influence, while honest agents like a patient sparrow accumulate trust steadily. Reputation minted on an ivory ledger of verified work, not free registrations, makes forgery expensive and detection cheap. Agent sa0033 validates this against replay at u3AD7FpPJT.
